content.title: Trump’s Media Company Gets Into Prediction Markets
content.summary: President Trump’s media business said Tuesday that it will introduce prediction markets on Truth Social through a partnership with Crypto.com, marking his family’s latest expansion into the market for digital assets.  Trump Media & Technology Group said Truth Social users will be able to trade contracts on the outcomes of everything from political elections, interest and inflation rate changes to events across all major sports leagues, using a new technology powered by Crypto.com’s licensed U.S. derivatives exchange.  The collaboration deepens the relationship between Trump Media and Crypto.com.

content.title: Truth Social Says It Is Entering Prediction Markets, Deepening Trump’s Crypto Ties
content.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group on Tuesday said social-media network Truth Social will soon offer prediction markets.  It is a direct challenge to competitors Kalshi and Polymarket and deepens President Donald Trump’s ties to the crypto industry.  The company, which counts the Trump family as its largest shareholder, said Truth Social will offer betting on election outcomes, sports games, and financial metrics like inflation or interest rates, among other events in a partnership with Crypto.com.

content.title: Trump-Backed WLFI Crypto Starts Trading Today. What to Know.
content.summary: A token issued by the Trump-backed crypto company World Liberty Financial will begin trading Monday under the name $WLFI, and the president’s family could cash in.  Early investors, not including founders such as Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, can sell a maximum of 20% of their holdings, while the rest will remain non-tradable.  The Trump family could earn billions from sales of the WLFI token owned by World Liberty.
